stem: A hose repeatedly crosses the main walking path in a cultivation room and workers keep stepping over it. Which control is strongest?
choices: Remind workers at the start of every shift to watch their step
Place a small warning sign beside the hose
Reroute or secure the hose so it no longer creates the recurring trip hazard
Require workers to walk more slowly near the hose
rationale: Changing the layout to remove or control the recurring hazard is stronger than relying only on warnings or worker attention.
